messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT (SEV2) — elevated tail latency and queue depth in eu-west routing lane. Smart-routing metric breach: lane_queue_depth > 80% for 4m, p99 latency spiked. Paging SRE oncall. https://ops.internal/alerts/1802501234 :rotating_light:

alice chen: saw it, grabbing traces now. looks like a surge from a handful of customers + a background batch job. correlation with new canary model rollout? pulling model traces.

alice chen: quick snapshot:
```
> region: eu-west
> lane: standard-cost (tier-2)
> p50: 38ms p95: 420ms p99: 1.9s
> queue_depth: 84%
> error_rate(5m): 0.7% (mostly 429/504 proxies)
```

omar patel: likely overload on standard-cost instances — traffic is spilling into lower-priority GPUs. Suggest immediate live mitigation: 1) apply regional lane shift to steer non-enterprise traffic to cheaper but lower-parallelism lane in ap-south (if latency allowed) OR 2) tighten per-key rate limits for bursty keys and temporarily disable streaming for standard tier.

alice chen: agree. i'll try targeted steering + soft quota first. want minimal customer impact.

priya singh: taking handoff (30m). priority: stop queue growth, avoid global throttles. Steps i'm going to run:
1) add temporary per-customer cap 60r/s for non-enterprise keys in eu-west
2) route 20% of standard-cost traffic to regional fallback lane in eu-west-2 with quantized models
3) disable streaming on standard-cost tier (reduce concurrency pressure)

priya singh: running command now:
```bash
# apply per-key soft cap
curl -X POST https://ops-internal.redwood.local/v1/quotas/softcaps \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"region":"eu-west","selector":"tier:standard-cost","soft_cap_rps":60,"expiration_minutes":30}'

# apply routing tweak: regional lane shift (20%)
rcli routing apply --policy regional-lane-shift \\
  --region eu-west --percent 20 --target-lane eu-west-2 --model-variant redwood-medium-q4
```

diego ramos: tagging customer success: @cs-team — AcmeCorp and BetaOrg might see reduced throughput/streaming. we'll post an incident banner if they report degradations.

oncall-sre: noticed a surge in one key: api_key=acct_9Xb2 — that's ~15% of the burst traffic. initiating per-key blocklist for repeated offenders (graceful 429).

alice chen: logs after priya's changes (2m after):
```
[22:41:12] lane_queue_depth eu-west -> 63%
[22:41:27] p95 latency -> 210ms
[22:42:01] p99 latency -> 610ms
[22:42:30] error_rate -> 0.2%
```

omar patel: looking better. keep streaming disabled until queue_depth < 50% for 10m. also recommend adding temporary quota to embeddings endpoints (heavy) and enable fallback model for region-specific steering.

priya singh: added embedding-specific caps and enabled fallback mapping for enterprise keys to always hit enterprise lane. command used:
```json
{"op":"update","target":"endpoint:embeddings","caps":{"tier:standard-cost":30,"tier:premium":200}}
```

diego ramos: CS notified customers with message: "We're applying temporary traffic shaping to stabilize latency; some non-enterprise requests may see reduced throughput or disabled streaming. We'll update in 30 minutes." :wave:

oncall-sre: handoff note for next oncall: keep an eye on lane_queue_depth eu-west, p99 latency, and any increase in errors from regional fallbacks. If p99 > 1s again, escalate and widen steering to 40%.

incident-bot: MITIGATION APPLIED — routing changes + soft caps + streaming disabled for standard tier. Monitoring for 30m.

alice chen: follow-up: create an action item to add autoscale for lane capacity when queue_depth trend > 60% for 5m, and playbook entry to prefer regional fallback before global throttles.

priya singh: closing the pager for now, moving to monitoring channel. will open a short postmortem draft and tag runtime/traffic for root cause (canary interaction + bursty key).

diego ramos: thanks team. i'll keep CS looped and schedule customer-impact review.

incident-bot: ALERT CLEARED — metrics stabilized. incident duration ~18m.

oncall-sre: raw action items:
- runtime: add auto-lane-scale rule (alice)
- infra: tune per-key detection for bursts (omar)
- product: evaluate canary release impact on routing (priya)
- cs: post customer banner + follow-up (diego)

alice chen: noted, filing tasks now.

priya singh: moving to #eng-runtime to run the postmortem template.
